purpose: Teach: せっせと/おっちゃん/大方/易く/総じて/ひそか/カワイイ/凄まじい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがせっせとお仕事に通ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father really does work so hard at his job, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle approval settling in the tone. Speaking as much to the moment as to Sho. Slight upward lilt at the end — inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが「おっちゃん」って自分のこと呼んでらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa called himself an "old-timer" the other day.
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh underneath the words. The delight of noticing something funny that adults miss. Eager to share the observation. Quick, light delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、大方のお友達は元気にしてらっしゃるわね
lines.en: Sho, most of your friends are doing well these days.
lines.style: Gentle checking-in, the way a mother smooths a conversation. Soft, conversational pace. Not quite a question, but open — inviting him to correct her if she's wrong.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんから易く折り紙の折り方を習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa taught me how to fold origami — it was really easy!
lines.style: Brightness in the voice, pride without showing off. The satisfaction of learning something and doing it right. Lean forward slightly. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは総じて穏やかな方ね
lines.en: Sho, your father is such a calm person, overall.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Reflective, almost philosophical — the thought of someone she loves settling in her voice. Slight pause before continuing, taking the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがひそかに涙されてたのを見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Grandpa crying quietly when he thought no one was looking.
lines.style: Serious, observant tone — the quiet perception of a child noticing something that matters. Soft, careful delivery. Not upset, just reporting something true. Slight hesitation before "crying," as if turning it over in his mind.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが「カワイイ孫だ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather said you're such a cute grandchild.
lines.style: Pleased warmth. The tenderness of passing along a compliment that touches her. Soft smile in the voice. Slow, savoring pace — wanting him to feel it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、運動会で凄まじい応援に驚いたよ
lines.en: Mom, at the sports day, Grandpa cheered so loudly — it surprised me!
lines.style: Bright, energized recall. The excitement of a remembered moment, told with affection and mild amazement. Alive in the telling. Quick pace, genuine delight underneath.
